The Chinese characters for Ashley

As a transliteration, Ashley is usually written 阿什利 (Ā shén lì). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

阿
Ā
a prefix, hill
什
shén
miscellaneous
利
lì
sharp, benefit

Origin and meaning

From English, Ashley carries the meaning “ash tree meadow”.

About the name Ashley

An English surname that swept to the top of US charts in the 1980s and 1990s.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Ashley as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “ash tree meadow”, is part of the appeal.
